properties.name: Device Type
properties.description: Device identity family to rediscover. Allowed values are exactly Server and Chassis.

properties.name: Device Organization
properties.description: Cisco Intersight organization used to scope the identity lookup through PermissionResources.Moid. The exact value is validated against the current organization Name schema and OData-escaped.

properties.name: Device Name
properties.description: Exact BladeIdentity, RackUnitIdentity, or ChassisIdentity Name. The value must not be blank and is OData-escaped before lookup.

properties.name: Server Form Factor
properties.description: Server identity routing: "Blade" queries only BladeIdentities, "Rack Unit" queries only RackUnitIdentities, and "Auto" queries both and requires exactly one combined match. Chassis requires "Auto".

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When false, success means only that AdminAction=Reack was accepted. When true, bounded polling must prove post-action progression before Applied with Active or Discovered is accepted as completion.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Conditionally required when Wait for Completion is true. Enter an integer from 1 through 600; it bounds the rediscovery polling window and is ignored when waiting is false.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final code. Accepted no-wait requests preserve the PATCH 2xx status, proven completion uses 200, timeout uses 408, validation/cardinality failures use 4xx, and handled helper/API or operation failures use 500/502.

properties.description: Validates Device Type, the conditional Server Form Factor routing contract, current organization Name constraints, an exact nonblank Device Name, and the conditional 1-600 second wait. It escapes organization and device names for OData single-quoted literals.
properties.display_name: Validate inputs and prepare identity routing
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "Workflow input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedDeviceName = ""
normalizedDeviceType = ""
normalizedServerFormFactor = ""
waitRequested = ""
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0

ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")

try:
    deviceType = sys.argv[1]
    organization = sys.argv[2]
    deviceName = sys.argv[3]
    serverFormFactor = sys.argv[4]
    waitText = sys.argv[5].strip().lower()
    timeoutText = sys.argv[6].strip()

    escapedOrganizationName = organization.replace("'", "''")
    escapedDeviceName = deviceName.replace("'", "''")
    errors = []

    if deviceType not in ("Server", "Chassis"):
        errors.append("Device Type must be exactly Server or Chassis.")
    else:
        normalizedDeviceType = deviceType

    if not organization:
        errors.append("Device Organization must not be blank.")
    elif not ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(organization):
        errors.append("Device Organization must match the current organization.Organization Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")

    if not deviceName.strip():
        errors.append("Device Name must not be blank.")

    if serverFormFactor not in ("Auto", "Blade", "Rack Unit"):
        errors.append("Server Form Factor must be exactly Auto, Blade, or Rack Unit.")
    elif deviceType == "Chassis" and serverFormFactor != "Auto":
        errors.append("Server Form Factor must be Auto when Device Type is Chassis.")
    else:
        normalizedServerFormFactor = serverFormFactor

    if waitText in ("true", "1"):
        waitRequested = "true"
    elif waitText in ("false", "0"):
        waitRequested = "false"
    else:
        waitRequested = "invalid"
        errors.append("Wait for Completion must be a boolean value.")

    try:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = int(timeoutText)
    except Exception:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = -1
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must be an integer.")

    if waitRequested == "true" and not (1 <= waitTimeoutSeconds <= 600):
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds is required when waiting and must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    if waitRequested == "false" and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must not be negative.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Input validation failed", "details": errors}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "Device routing, organization, exact-name OData value, and bounded-wait inputs are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"validated": True, "deviceType": normalizedDeviceType, "serverFormFactor": normalizedServerFormFactor, "waitForCompletion": waitRequested == "true", "waitTimeoutSeconds": waitTimeoutSeconds if waitRequested == "true" else None}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Workflow input preparation failed", "detail": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

actions.title: Inspect exact organization match

properties.description: Requires exactly one organization response item with the exact Name, organization.Organization ObjectType, and a usable Moid before any identity collection is queried.
properties.display_name: Inspect exact organization match
properties.script:
import json
import sys

organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
organizationStatusCode = "500"
organizationMessage = "Organization lookup inspection did not complete."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The organization response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    count = len(results)
    if count != 1:
        organizationStatus = "cardinality"
        organizationStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        organizationMessage = "The organization lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % count
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup cardinality failure", "matchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single organization result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching organization is missing a usable Moid."
        elif name != expectedName:
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching organization Name does not equal the requested exact value."
        elif objectType != "organization.Organization":
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching resource ObjectType is not organization.Organization."
        else:
            organizationMoid = moid
            organizationStatus = "ready"
            organizationStatusCode = "200"
            organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization with the expected identity was resolved."
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType}, separators=(",", ":"))
        if organizationStatus == "invalid-resource":
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
    organizationStatusCode = "500"
    organizationMessage = str(exc)
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup inspection failed", "detail": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

actions.title: Inspect exact routed identity match

properties.description: Parses only the response bodies required by the normalized route. Explicit Blade and Rack Unit use one collection; Auto combines both and requires exactly one total match; Chassis uses only ChassisIdentity. It validates exact Name, concrete ObjectType, organization PermissionResources, Moid, and current state enums while capturing the pre-action AdminActionState and Lifecycle.
properties.display_name: Inspect exact routed identity match
properties.script:
import json
import sys

identityStatus = "helper-failure"
identityStatusCode = "500"
identityMessage = "Identity lookup inspection did not complete."
identityResultJson = json.dumps({"error": identityMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
identityMoid = ""
identityObjectType = ""
identityItemBase = ""
preAdminActionState = ""
preLifecycle = ""

ADMIN_STATES = {"None", "Applied", "Applying", "Failed", "Scheduled"}
LIFECYCLE_STATES = {
    "None", "Active", "Decommissioned", "DecommissionInProgress", "RecommissionInProgress",
    "OperationFailed", "ReackInProgress", "RemoveInProgress", "Discovered",
    "DiscoveryInProgress", "DiscoveryFailed", "FirmwareUpgradeInProgress",
    "DiagnosticsInProgress", "SecureEraseInProgress", "ScrubInProgress",
    "BladeMigrationInProgress", "Inactive", "ReplaceInProgress", "SlotMismatch",
    "ReplacementPendingUserAction", "Removed", "Moved", "Replaced", "MovedAndReplaced",
    "DomainRmaPendingUserAction", "IdentityUnknown", "RestoreConfigInProgress"
}
BASES = {
    "compute.BladeIdentity": "/api/v1/compute/BladeIdentities",
    "compute.RackUnitIdentity": "/api/v1/compute/RackUnitIdentities",
    "equipment.ChassisIdentity": "/api/v1/equipment/ChassisIdentities"
}

def results_from(text, label, required):
    if not required:
        return []
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        raise ValueError(label + " response body is missing.")
    payload = json.loads(text)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError(label + " response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError(label + " response does not contain a Results array.")
    return results

try:
    bladeBody, rackBody, chassisBody = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    deviceType, formFactor = sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    expectedName, expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7]

    needBlade = deviceType == "Server" and formFactor in ("Auto", "Blade")
    needRack = deviceType == "Server" and formFactor in ("Auto", "Rack Unit")
    needChassis = deviceType == "Chassis" and formFactor == "Auto"
    if not ((needChassis and not needBlade and not needRack) or (deviceType == "Server" and not needChassis and (needBlade or needRack))):
        raise ValueError("The normalized device routing tuple is inconsistent.")

    bladeResults = results_from(bladeBody, "Blade identity", needBlade)
    rackResults = results_from(rackBody, "Rack unit identity", needRack)
    chassisResults = results_from(chassisBody, "Chassis identity", needChassis)
    combined = bladeResults + rackResults + chassisResults
    count = len(combined)

    if count != 1:
        identityStatus = "cardinality"
        identityStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        identityMessage = "The routed identity lookup returned %d combined matches; exactly one is required." % count
        identityResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Identity lookup cardinality failure", "deviceType": deviceType, "serverFormFactor": formFactor, "bladeMatches": len(bladeResults), "rackUnitMatches": len(rackResults), "chassisMatches": len(chassisResults), "combinedMatchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = combined[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single identity result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Inspect rediscovery request acceptance

properties.description: Validates the successful PATCH response as the same identity and organization-scoped resource, checks current AdminActionState and Lifecycle enums, stops on documented failure states, and records whether the response itself proves a state change or explicit progress. HTTP success remains accepted-not-completed.
properties.display_name: Inspect rediscovery request acceptance
properties.script:
import json
import sys

acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
acceptanceMessage = "Rediscovery response inspection did not complete."
acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": acceptanceMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
acceptanceProgressObserved = "false"

ADMIN_STATES = {"None", "Applied", "Applying", "Failed", "Scheduled"}
LIFECYCLE_STATES = {
    "None", "Active", "Decommissioned", "DecommissionInProgress", "RecommissionInProgress",
    "OperationFailed", "ReackInProgress", "RemoveInProgress", "Discovered",
    "DiscoveryInProgress", "DiscoveryFailed", "FirmwareUpgradeInProgress",
    "DiagnosticsInProgress", "SecureEraseInProgress", "ScrubInProgress",
    "BladeMigrationInProgress", "Inactive", "ReplaceInProgress", "SlotMismatch",
    "ReplacementPendingUserAction", "Removed", "Moved", "Replaced", "MovedAndReplaced",
    "DomainRmaPendingUserAction", "IdentityUnknown", "RestoreConfigInProgress"
}
PROGRESS_ADMIN = {"Applying", "Scheduled"}
PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE = {"ReackInProgress", "DiscoveryInProgress"}
FAILURE_LIFECYCLE = {"DiscoveryFailed", "OperationFailed"}

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid, expectedName, expectedObjectType, expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    preAdminState, preLifecycle, deviceType = sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7], sys.argv[8]
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The rediscovery response body is not a JSON object.")
    moid, name, objectType = item.get("Moid"), item.get("Name"), item.get("ObjectType")
    permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
    permissionMoidList = [rel.get("Moid") for rel in permissions if isinstance(rel, dict)] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
    adminState, lifecycle = item.get("AdminActionState"), item.get("Lifecycle")
    error = ""
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        error = "The rediscovery response Moid does not match the selected identity."
    elif name != expectedName:
        error = "The rediscovery response Name does not match the selected identity."
    elif objectType != expectedObjectType:
        error = "The rediscovery response ObjectType does not match the selected identity."
    elif expectedOrganizationMoid not in permissionMoidList:
        error = "The rediscovery response PermissionResources do not contain the resolved organization Moid."
    elif adminState not in ADMIN_STATES:
        error = "The rediscovery response AdminActionState is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum."
    elif lifecycle not in LIFECYCLE_STATES:
        error = "The rediscovery response Lifecycle is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum."
    if error:
        acceptanceStatus = "invalid-resource"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "502"
        acceptanceMessage = error
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": error, "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif adminState == "Failed" or lifecycle in FAILURE_LIFECYCLE:
        acceptanceStatus = "operation-failure"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "502"
        acceptanceMessage = "The accepted rediscovery response already reports a documented failure state."
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completionVerified": False, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType, "AdminActionState": adminState, "Lifecycle": lifecycle, "error": acceptanceMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        progressed = adminState in PROGRESS_ADMIN or lifecycle in PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE or adminState != preAdminState or lifecycle != preLifecycle
        acceptanceProgressObserved = "true" if progressed else "false"
        acceptanceStatus = "ready"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "202"
        acceptanceMessage = "Cisco Intersight accepted AdminAction=Reack; rediscovery completion has not been verified."
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completionVerified": False, "deviceType": deviceType, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType, "preActionAdminActionState": preAdminState, "preActionLifecycle": preLifecycle, "returnedAdminAction": item.get("AdminAction"), "returnedAdminActionState": adminState, "returnedLifecycle": lifecycle, "progressObservedInPatchResponse": progressed}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
    acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
    acceptanceMessage = str(exc)
    acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Rediscovery response inspection failed", "detail": acceptanceMessage, "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

actions.name: Execute Python Script
actions.title: Initialize bounded rediscovery polling

properties.description: Starts the 1-600 second wait window only after safe acceptance inspection and derives one initial delay plus four inter-poll delays below the 180-second helper timeout, for at most five identity GET attempts.
properties.display_name: Initialize bounded rediscovery polling
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
pollingStatusCode = "500"
pollingMessage = "Polling deadline initialization did not complete."
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
deadlineEpoch = ""
initialDelaySeconds = ""
pollIntervalSeconds = ""

try:
    timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
    if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600:
        raise ValueError("The normalized wait timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    now = time.time()
    initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0))
    interval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
    if initialDelay > 2.0 or interval >= 180.0:
        raise ValueError("The derived polling delays exceed safe helper action bounds.")
    deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout)
    initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay
    pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % interval
    pollingStatus = "ready"
    pollingStatusCode = "200"
    pollingMessage = "A bounded polling deadline and safe delay schedule were initialized."
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"waitTimeoutSeconds": timeout, "initialDelaySeconds": initialDelay, "pollIntervalSeconds": interval, "maximumPollAttempts": 5}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollingStatusCode = "500"
    pollingMessage = str(exc)
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Polling deadline initialization failed", "detail": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Sleeps for no more than the smaller of the validated delay and remaining deadline before current poll; a deadline already reached returns an explicit timeout before another GET.
properties.display_name: Wait before rediscovery state current poll
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

waitStatus = "helper-failure"
waitStatusCode = "500"
waitMessage = "Polling delay did not complete."
waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
    initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
    pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
    attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
    stagePrefix = sys.argv[5]
    if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
        raise ValueError("The polling attempt must be between 1 and 5.")
    requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 1 else pollInterval
    stage = stagePrefix + " " + str(attempt)
    if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
        raise ValueError("The requested polling delay is outside the safe helper action bound.")
    remaining = deadline - time.time()
    if remaining <= 0:
        waitStatus = "timeout"
        waitStatusCode = "408"
        waitMessage = "The rediscovery wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "completionVerified": False, "timeout": True, "stage": stage}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
        time.sleep(actualDelay)
        waitStatus = "ready"
        waitStatusCode = "200"
        waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage": stage, "requestedDelaySeconds": requestedDelay, "actualDelaySeconds": actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    waitStatus = "helper-failure"
    waitStatusCode = "500"
    waitMessage = str(exc)
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Polling delay helper failed", "detail": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

    "OperationFailed", "ReackInProgress", "RemoveInProgress", "Discovered",
    "DiscoveryInProgress", "DiscoveryFailed", "FirmwareUpgradeInProgress",
    "DiagnosticsInProgress", "SecureEraseInProgress", "ScrubInProgress",
    "BladeMigrationInProgress", "Inactive", "ReplaceInProgress", "SlotMismatch",
    "ReplacementPendingUserAction", "Removed", "Moved", "Replaced", "MovedAndReplaced",
    "DomainRmaPendingUserAction", "IdentityUnknown", "RestoreConfigInProgress"
}
PROGRESS_ADMIN = {"Applying", "Scheduled"}
PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE = {"ReackInProgress", "DiscoveryInProgress"}
FAILURE_LIFECYCLE = {"DiscoveryFailed", "OperationFailed"}
SUCCESS_LIFECYCLE = {"Active", "Discovered"}

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid, expectedName, expectedObjectType, expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    preAdminState, preLifecycle, priorProgressText, deviceType = sys.argv[6], sys.argv[7], sys.argv[8], sys.argv[9]
    attempt = int(sys.argv[10])
    if priorProgressText not in ("true", "false"):
        raise ValueError("The prior progression flag is not normalized.")
    priorProgress = priorProgressText == "true"
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The identity polling response body is not a JSON object.")
    moid, name, objectType = item.get("Moid"), item.get("Name"), item.get("ObjectType")
    permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
    permissionMoidList = [rel.get("Moid") for rel in permissions if isinstance(rel, dict)] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
    adminState, currentLifecycle = item.get("AdminActionState"), item.get("Lifecycle")
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity Moid does not match the selected identity.")
    if name != expectedName:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity Name does not match the selected identity.")
    if objectType != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity ObjectType does not match the selected identity.")
    if expectedOrganizationMoid not in permissionMoidList:
        raise ValueError("The polled identity PermissionResources do not contain the resolved organization Moid.")
    if adminState not in ADMIN_STATES:
        raise ValueError("The polled AdminActionState is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum.")
    if currentLifecycle not in LIFECYCLE_STATES:
        raise ValueError("The polled Lifecycle is missing or outside the current OpenAPI enum.")

    adminActionState = adminState
    lifecycle = currentLifecycle
    changed = adminState != preAdminState or currentLifecycle != preLifecycle
    explicitProgress = adminState in PROGRESS_ADMIN or currentLifecycle in PROGRESS_LIFECYCLE
    progressed = priorProgress or changed or explicitProgress
    progressObserved = "true" if progressed else "false"
    base = {"requestAccepted": True, "deviceType": deviceType, "Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType, "pollAttempt": attempt, "preActionAdminActionState": preAdminState, "preActionLifecycle": preLifecycle, "AdminActionState": adminState, "Lifecycle": currentLifecycle, "progressObserved": progressed}

    if adminState == "Failed" or currentLifecycle in FAILURE_LIFECYCLE:
        pollStatus = "failure"
        pollStatusCode = "502"
        pollMessage = "Device rediscovery reached a documented failure state."
        base["rediscoveryCompleted"] = False
    elif adminState == "Applied" and currentLifecycle in SUCCESS_LIFECYCLE:
        if progressed:
            pollStatus = "success"
            pollStatusCode = "200"
            pollMessage = "Device rediscovery progressed and completed with AdminActionState=Applied and Lifecycle=%s." % currentLifecycle
            base["rediscoveryCompleted"] = True
        else:
            pollStatus = "awaiting-progress"
            pollStatusCode = "202"
            pollMessage = "The identity is in a terminal-looking success pair but no post-action progression has been proven yet."
            base["rediscoveryCompleted"] = False
    elif explicitProgress:
        pollStatus = "in-progress"
        pollStatusCode = "202"
        pollMessage = "Device rediscovery is in an explicitly documented nonterminal state."
        base["rediscoveryCompleted"] = False
    elif not priorProgress and not changed:
        pollStatus = "awaiting-progress"
        pollStatusCode = "202"
        pollMessage = "The identity still matches its captured pre-action state; waiting for rediscovery progression."
        base["rediscoveryCompleted"] = False
    else:
        pollStatus = "failure"
        pollStatusCode = "502"
        pollMessage = "The changed identity state is neither documented rediscovery progress, terminal success, nor a documented failure state; polling stopped fail-closed."
        base["rediscoveryCompleted"] = False
        base["failClosed"] = True
    pollResultJson = json.dumps(base, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollStatusCode = "500"
    pollMessage = str(exc)
    pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Rediscovery state inspection failed", "detail": pollMessage, "requestAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Requests rediscovery of exactly one Blade, Rack Unit, or Chassis using AdminAction=Reack. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations/identities and update it. Matching is exact and PermissionResources-scoped; explicit Blade/Rack routes query only their collection, while Auto requires one combined server match. Identity and pre-action AdminActionState/Lifecycle are validated. Wait=false means HTTP 2xx acceptance only. Wait=true uses a finite 1-600 second schedule and requires progression to Applied with Lifecycle Active/Discovered; documented failures fail, known Reack/discovery progress continues, and other changed states fail closed. A final GET may finish after deadline. Reack is non-idempotent, so reruns can submit another request. Generic APIs are used because no complete atomic exists.
